modules.title: Hear the people affected
modules.objective: Listen to access and maintenance concerns before asking the group to make a shared decision.
modules.entry: Begin when the community is considering work on its shared facilities. Existing action rules determine whether each conversation is available.

provenance.note: Fictional Kestrel Flats campaign characters and dialogue; not a real community record.

nodes.prompt: Whose concerns will you hear first?

choices.label: Hear Mara on access
choices.outcome: Mara's access concern enters the shared project record.

choices.label: Hear Eli on maintenance
choices.outcome: Eli's maintenance concern enters the shared project record.

nodes.prompt: One resident has spoken. Hear from the other before convening a committee.

choices.label: Hear Mara on access
choices.outcome: Mara's access concern enters the shared project record.

choices.label: Hear Eli on maintenance
choices.outcome: Eli's maintenance concern enters the shared project record.

nodes.prompt: Both concerns are recorded. You can invite the residents to make a decision together.

choices.label: Convene the project committee
choices.outcome: The residents convene a committee with a community mandate.

modules.title: Pick and decide on the fruit
modules.objective: Choose whether the harvest first supports neighbours or earns funds for shared work.
modules.entry: The campaign rule set requires a planted orchard, available labour and an undecided harvest.
modules.duration: One workday plus an optional follow-up

provenance.note: Fictional campaign activity; no claim about a real orchard, crop or seasonal job.

nodes.prompt: The fruit is ready. How will the first harvest be used?

choices.label: Reserve fruit for the commons
choices.outcome: The harvest is stored for a shared gathering.

choices.label: Sell fruit at the market
choices.outcome: The harvest earns three coins for later community choices.

nodes.prompt: The fruit is reserved. You can host the gathering or use other campaign options.

choices.label: Host a gathering with the reserve
choices.outcome: The commons opens with stored food.

nodes.prompt: The fruit was sold. The shared food and trade decisions remain in the campaign ledger.

choices.label: Launch the trade route
choices.outcome: The first trade boat sets out.

modules.title: Repair and return a vehicle to service
modules.objective: Use available parts, labour and workshop capacity to complete a repair order.
modules.entry: The shared campaign gates determine whether the workshop or vehicle repair action can proceed.

provenance.note: Fictional repair choices use the existing shared campaign actions and inventory.

nodes.prompt: Choose the repair the crew can support with current resources.

choices.label: Repair the water tank with salvaged fittings
choices.outcome: The tank returns to service without buying a replacement fitting.

choices.label: Repair the water tank with purchased parts
choices.outcome: The purchased fitting returns the tank to service.

choices.label: Complete the workshop repair order
choices.outcome: The repair order is delivered and campaign funds change through the existing rule.

modules.title: Prepare a shared meal
modules.objective: Choose how the community gathers around available food and shared funds.
modules.entry: A planted orchard and the harvest decision are checked by campaign actions; this fixture contains no nutritional guidance.

provenance.note: Fictional campaign event. It is not recipe, allergy, health or nutrition advice; a reviewed food dataset adapter is a future source.

nodes.prompt: Choose how to prepare the gathering around the harvest.

choices.label: Use food reserved for the commons
choices.outcome: The shared reserve supports the gathering.

choices.label: Host a gathering with the harvest
choices.outcome: The harvest gathering changes shared campaign state through the action receipt.

modules.title: Housekeeping practice shift
modules.objective: Prioritise a room task while balancing the guest's request, hygiene and the next arrival.
modules.entry: A self-contained fictional training vignette, separate from the mapped Kestrel and Saltwind community sites.

accessibility.interaction: Two-stage labelled choices; no timed input

provenance.note: Fictional motel-room scenario. It does not represent a real employer, property, vacancy or service.

nodes.prompt: A guest needs fresh towels while the room is due for its next arrival. What do you prioritise first?

choices.label: Respond to the guest, then finish the linen reset
choices.outcome: The guest request is recorded as the first priority.

choices.label: Finish the hygiene check before restocking
choices.outcome: The hygiene check is recorded as the first priority.

choices.label: Use the checklist to sequence the room
choices.outcome: The checklist sequence is recorded as the first priority.

nodes.prompt: Complete the room check and record the practice shift.

choices.label: Finish the practice shift
choices.outcome: The practice task is complete; no currency or real employment claim is created.
